text: You see Vasquez, the mercenary desperado.
source_text: You see Vasquez, the mercenary desperado.

text: You see a seedy-looking gunman.
source_text: You see a seedy-looking gunman.

text: What do you want?
source_text: What do you want?

text: Who are you?
source_text: Who are you?

text: Hnn.
source_text: Hnn.

text: I do not work for the weak of mind. You leave now.
source_text: I do not work for the weak of mind. You leave now.

text: You have not heard of me? I am hurt! My name is Vasquez Villanova Hernandez Ortega. I am a famous desperado, my friend. And, if you have need, I am a gun for hire.
source_text:
You have not heard of me? I am hurt! My name is Vasquez
 Villanova Hernandez Ortega. I am a famous desperado,
 my friend. And, if you have need, I am a gun for hire.

text: Really? How much do you cost?
source_text: Really? How much do you cost?

text: See you around, maybe . . . good luck. Heh.
source_text: See you around, maybe . . . good luck. Heh.

text: Ahh, straight to the point, my friend. Excellent. I will help you around town for a measly $500 a week. My services are not cheap, but then again, I am worth it.
source_text:
Ahh, straight to the point, my friend. Excellent. I will help
 you around town for a measly $500 a week. My services are
 not cheap, but then again, I am worth it.

text: Great, I'll hire you. Here's $500.
source_text: Great, I'll hire you. Here's $500.

text: Sorry to bother you, but I don't think I need your services.
source_text:
Sorry to bother you, but I don't think I need your
 services.

text: I am sorry, my friend, but I do not work for imaginary money. I need cold, hard cash.
source_text:
I am sorry, my friend, but I do not work for
 imaginary money. I need cold, hard cash.

text: Excellent. I am yours. Let us go, this place bores me.
source_text: Excellent. I am yours. Let us go, this place bores me.

text: Lead on, I am yours to command!
source_text: Lead on, I am yours to command!

text: Let us get something to drink!
source_text: Let us get something to drink!

text: Where shall we go first?
source_text: Where shall we go first?

text: As long as you stay in Junktown, I am yours. I do not like leaving this town.
source_text:
As long as you stay in Junktown, I am yours. I do not
 like leaving this town.

text: Did you know that I have a bounty on my head? It is too small, however.
source_text:
Did you know that I have a bounty on my head?
 It is too small, however.

text: Ah, my friend. It is good to see you again.
source_text: Ah, my friend. It is good to see you again.

text: I want to hire you for a week.
source_text: I want to hire you for a week.

text: Nice meeting you again.
source_text: Nice meeting you again.

text: Hnn.
source_text: Hnn.

text: Well, maybe it is not so good to see you again. Have a good day.
source_text:
Well, maybe it is not so good to see you again. Have
 a good day.

text: Of course you do. My bill is small, and my worth is so large. $500, please.
source_text:
Of course you do. My bill is small, and my worth is
 so large. $500, please.

text: Here you go.
source_text: Here you go.

text: You should not have done that, my soon to be dead friend.
source_text:
You should not have done that, my soon to be dead
 friend.
